LanguageData.HR_Character_ZhouYouWang.label: King You of Zhou
LanguageData.HR_Character_ZhouYouWang.description: Last king of Western Zhou. His stable identity is recorded; his birth year and exact age are unknown.
LanguageData.HR_Character_BoPan.label: Bo Pan
LanguageData.HR_Character_BoPan.description: Traditionally described as a son of King You; also known as Bo Fu. His birth year is unknown.
LanguageData.HR_Character_YiJiu.label: Yi Jiu (later King Ping of Zhou)
LanguageData.HR_Character_YiJiu.description: Son of King You and later King Ping. His location during the Lishan crisis is disputed.
LanguageData.HR_Character_ShenHou.label: Marquis of Shen
LanguageData.HR_Character_ShenHou.description: A political figure of Shen. This phase does not assume he personally fought at Lishan.
